Review.Subarea: Default Mask Rendering Under Real Login + Role Switch
Review.ItemLabel: UAT-1: BackofficeUser (via role-switch from admin) sees the SSN masked when no exemption is active

Steps.Action: NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/login"
CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
VERIFY TEXT contains "We sent a sign-in code to"
NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/dev/email-inbox"
FOLLOW LINK IN NEW TAB with text "Open"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "System Admin"
CLICK MENU ITEM with label "Backoffice User"
VERIFY SNACKBAR shows "Now viewing as 'Backoffice User'."
CLICK LINK with text "Retail Businesses"
CLICK INPUT with label "Last Name" and enter "Smith"
CLICK ROW in "Retail Businesses" where "Account Email" = "james.smith@example.com"
VERIFY URL matches "/customers/[0-9]+$"
VERIFY TEXT contains "XXX-XX-"
VERIFY ELEMENT with label "Social Security Number" is not visible

Review.ItemLabel: UAT-2: SystemAdmin grants a Customer.SocialSecurityNumber mask exemption to BackofficeUser

Steps.Action: NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/login"
CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
VERIFY TEXT contains "We sent a sign-in code to"
NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/dev/email-inbox"
FOLLOW LINK IN NEW TAB with text "Open"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Admin"
CLICK LINK with text "Security Dashboard"
CLICK TAB with name "ROLE MASTER DETAILS"
CLICK ROW in "Role Master Details" where "Display alias" = "Backoffice User"
CLICK TAB with name "Mask Exemptions"
OPEN DROPDOWN with label "Table" and select item whose text = "Customer"
OPEN DROPDOWN with label "Column" and select item whose text = "SocialSecurityNumber"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Add"
VERIFY ROW in "Mask Exemptions" where "Column" = "SocialSecurityNumber" and "Status" = "Active" exists
